# Fixture del host GTK: llamadas run_javascript y sus envoltorios.
def _dash_js(code):
    try:
        wv.run_javascript(
            f"try{{{code}}}catch(e){{console.error('dash_js: '+(e&&e.stack||e))}}", None, None, None)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"_dash_js fallo: {e}")


def _dash_click(elem_id):
    def go(*_):
        wv.run_javascript(f"try{{document.getElementById('{elem_id}').click()}}catch(e){{}}", None, None, None)
    return go


wv.run_javascript("try{typeof pomoRender==='function'&&pomoRender()}catch(e){}", None, None, None)
_dash_js(f"render({json.dumps(sess)})")
btn.connect("clicked", _dash_click("btn-notif"))
_dash_js('ghostFn();'
         'window.Bee&&Bee.helper()')


def _dbg():
    with open(path) as fh:
        code = fh.read()
    _dash_js(code)


ucm.register_script_message_handler("centro")
